column1: # Permanent provenance for externally informed DelosDB runtime test authorities.

column7: Use deterministic random seeds, bounded grammar generation, generated predicates and heterogeneous values, indexed/unindexed comparison, joins, correlated subqueries, grouping, boundary-value types, and long deterministic campaigns to expose optimizer and execution mismatches with replayable failures
column8: Independently authored DelosDB generator compares heap/MVCC and indexed/unindexed tables across mutations, SQLState classes, expressions, predicates, joins, subqueries, grouped aggregates, bounded query generation, reduction, common SQL types, non-overlapping seed windows, results, and final state; no H2 code copied

column7: Crashes around DDL metadata commit must recover to a wholly old or wholly new schema with usable data and indexes
column8: Independently authored DelosDB process-crash matrix puts heap ALTER ADD COLUMN plus heap/MVCC CREATE INDEX in one RawStore transaction with an isolated MVCC commit witness and proves old-or-new catalog, data, and forced-index usability after reopen; no MariaDB code copied

column7: A transaction selected as deadlock victim while resuming through a changing wait graph must not continue as if a cancelled later lock were held
column8: Independently authored DelosDB lock-manager cycle forces grant/deadlock wake-up races in both signal orders and proves 40001, no phantom victim grant, survivor resume, and waiter cleanup; no MariaDB code copied
